scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title song before Chun Yuqiao and Xie Ling meet in the lounge.

scenes.title: Honey Pomelo Tea and Liu Fan's Comeback
scenes.summary: Rival producer Xie Ling expects Chun Yuqiao to gloat over Twelve Singers, but Yuqiao orders him honey pomelo tea and explains how he quietly arranged singer Liu Fan's comeback.

scenes.title: Pulling Out Every Mole
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao warns Xie Ling never again to plant informants at Xingtian, tells him the mole is already gone, and leaves the loser to pay the lounge bill.

scenes.title: Keeping the Honest Intern
scenes.summary: After Xingtian dismisses Wang Er for leaking guest plans to ME, Chun Yuqiao clears honest intern Bu Xiaogu, brings her into the chief editor's office, and assigns Xingzi to mentor her.

scenes.title: Do Interns Draw a Salary?
scenes.summary: Ji Xiu praises Chun Yuqiao's secret Plan A, while upset Bu Xiaogu accuses Yuqiao of using staff as pawns and gets a blunt lecture on what real television production takes.

scenes.title: Do You Want This Job or Not?
scenes.summary: Xingzi tells Bu Xiaogu that Wang Er was fired for leaking guest plans and offers her a place in the chief editor's office; Chun Yuqiao hands Xiaogu the Star Night shortlist due tomorrow.

scenes.title: Late Nights Over Hotpot
scenes.summary: Over hotpot with Qin Xiao, Bu Xiaogu recalls Professor Fang's media ethics lessons and discusses diva Xin Huimei's controversial new single cover while rushing both work and her thesis.

scenes.title: Lawsuit Trouble and Backup Guest Li Mingji
scenes.summary: Xiaogu reports that Xin Huimei tops audience surveys for finals night, but Kaiwen reveals Huimei is suing Yuanye Records over an unauthorised cover photo, so Chun Yuqiao sends Xiaogu after retro star Li Mingji.

scenes.title: One Day Left to Decide on DTS
scenes.summary: Professor Fang calls Bu Xiaogu about her approaching thesis deadline and gives her until tomorrow to make a final decision on the prestigious DTS network job offer.

scenes.title: Coffee With a Label Insider
scenes.summary: Xingzi treats a Yuanye Records manager to an Americano and learns that Xin Huimei's label has frozen all her stage performances, including Twelve Singers.

scenes.title: Landing Both Guests at Once
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu finally locks in Li Mingji's schedule after endless demands, right as Xingzi calls Kaiwen with surprise news that Xin Huimei has agreed to appear on the show.

scenes.title: Misunderstanding Over Plan B
scenes.summary: Holding pages of call notes, Bu Xiaogu confronts Chun Yuqiao for wasting her work on Li Mingji and is ordered out, until Kaiwen explains Huimei is only doing the semifinal and Li Mingji remains Plan A.

scenes.title: Food Poisoning on the Studio Floor
scenes.summary: When the studio floor crew land in hospital with food poisoning before the semifinal taping, Bu Xiaogu volunteers to help on site and Chun Yuqiao sends her over while Kaiwen teases him.

scenes.title: Reporting to Lin Jie at Studio One
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu reports to Studio One floor director Lin Jie two days before taping, gets told to find work on her own in the busy studio, and wins the crew's approval.

scenes.title: Never Take Sides in a Label Dispute
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao wonders why variety-shy Xin Huimei agreed to appear, warns Kaiwen not to take sides between Huimei and Yuanye Records, and orders that no rookie handle Li Mingji.

scenes.title: Oversleeping in the Dorm
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu wakes at eleven in a panic after Qin Xiao turned off her alarm so she would not collapse from exhaustion, leaving her thesis unfinished and late for work.

scenes.title: Choosing to Stay at Xingtian
scenes.summary: After Lin Jie reminds exhausted Bu Xiaogu that she still has gentler career options, Xiaogu phones Professor Fang to turn down DTS and vows to stay at Xingtian even on the floor crew.

scenes.title: Redesigning the Backstage Layout
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu proposes reorganising the cramped backstage dressing rooms overnight and wins Lin Jie's praise with a clear floor plan just as guest mentor Xin Huimei arrives.

scenes.title: Guiding Guests Backstage
scenes.summary: Backstage crew members usher guests toward the dressing rooms and check contestant cue numbers before the semifinal begins.

scenes.title: Questioning the Verdict Onstage
scenes.summary: Host Wen Simo opens the semifinal while Chun Yuqiao directs cameras; invited to critique singer Bai Yang, guest mentor Xin Huimei praises her voice and suddenly challenges whether her comments can change the outcome.
scenes.location: Studio One stage and control room

scenes.title: Confrontation Over Luo Lin
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei storms offstage to confront Chun Yuqiao in the control area, accusing him of sabotaging Bai Yang because her voice resembles his ex-girlfriend Luo Lin, and warns that his past cannot be cut out.
scenes.location: Studio One control area and stage

scenes.title: Finding the Moved Lounge
scenes.summary: When Chun Yuqiao suffers stomach pain after the onstage uproar, Bu Xiaogu guides him to the newly relocated backstage lounge and quietly receives his thanks before returning to work.

scenes.title: Leaked Clip Goes Viral
scenes.summary: Xingzi discovers that Xin Huimei and Luo Lin are best friends; although Kaiwen cut the outburst from broadcast, a leaked audience clip goes viral on Weibo after Huimei reposts it and reporter Bianbian pushes a headline.

scenes.title: PR Director Stella Clashes With Production
scenes.summary: PR director Stella brings an aggressive media counter-plan to the chief editor's office, clashes with Xingzi and Kaiwen when Chun Yuqiao calls it extreme, and is told by Yuqiao to find reporter Bianbian first.

scenes.title: Tracking Down Reporter Bianbian
scenes.summary: Back in her office, Stella pauses the press release, calls Lutiao News to track down Bianbian, and is startled when Bianbian answers the line himself and agrees to meet.

scenes.title: A Producer Stays Behind the Scenes
scenes.summary: Xingzi and Kaiwen urge Chun Yuqiao to clear his name publicly, but Yuqiao warns that provoking Xin Huimei's twenty million fans would disrupt the live finale and insists a professional producer stays strictly behind the scenes.
